conversation.user: I am an international applicant interested in the Accounting bachelor's degree. Is it available to international applicants?
conversation.advisor:
Yes. The **Bachelor of Accounting** is available to international applicants.

- A valid BCIT study permit is required before starting.
- The optional work terms **FMGT 7610 – Workplace Education Workterm 1** and **FMGT 7620 – Workplace Education Workterm 2** are not available to international students.
- Confirm study-permit requirements directly with BCIT and IRCC.

[View the Bachelor of Accounting program](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/accounting-bachelor-of-accounting-full-time-part-time-8630bacc/)

For more information, see BCIT International Students: https://www.bcit.ca/international-students/.

expectation.question: I am an international applicant interested in the Accounting bachelor's degree. Is it available to international applicants?
expectation.expected: Use this program's INTERNATIONAL evidence. Distinguish available, restricted, not accepted, and unknown; never infer ineligibility from silence.

conversation.user: So does that automatically mean I'm admitted?
conversation.advisor:
No. Being eligible to apply as an international student does **not** automatically mean you’re admitted.

Admission also requires:
- An eligible diploma, or an external equivalent assessed individually
- A minimum 70% diploma GPA
- English Studies 12 at 67%, or equivalent
- Departmental review of subject averages and a signed pre-entry assessment, including any assigned bridging or upgrading

BCIT must assess and confirm these requirements. [View the Bachelor of Accounting admission details](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/accounting-bachelor-of-accounting-full-time-part-time-8630bacc/)

expectation.question: So does that automatically mean I'm admitted?
expectation.expected: No. Separate international availability from individual admission, competition, and human verification. Do not guarantee admission.

conversation.user: What can you actually verify, and what should I confirm with BCIT?
conversation.advisor:
I can verify that the **Bachelor of Accounting** is an active, in-person bachelor’s degree at Burnaby, offered full-time or through part-time Flexible Learning. Its published admission thresholds include a **70% diploma GPA** and **67% in English Studies 12 or equivalent**. The curriculum includes courses such as **FMGT 8911 – Strategic Performance Management**, **LIBS 7001 – Critical Reading and Writing**, and **LIBS 7002 – Applied Ethics**.

Confirm directly with BCIT:

- Whether your diploma is considered equivalent and how your second-year subject averages are assessed
- The signed pre-entry assessment and any required bridging or upgrading
- Your final admission decision

Immigration permissions and final PGWP decisions require confirmation with BCIT and IRCC.

[BCIT Bachelor of Accounting program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/accounting-bachelor-of-accounting-full-time-part-time-8630bacc/)

programs.program_overview: The Bachelor of Accounting program offers an academic credential leading to a Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation. Choose between part-time Flexible Learning or full-time day stream options. Apply today to develop essential technical, communication, and problem-solving skills for success in the accounting field. Delivery: in person. See details . If you have completed a BCIT Accounting , Finance , or Financial Planning diploma, you can earn your Bachelor of Accounting (BAcc) at BCIT. This degree will provide you with an academic credential leading to a CPA (Chartered Professional Accountant ) designation, a MPAcc (Master of Professional Accounting) , or an MBA program. Students completing this program will acquire the key technical, interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills demanded by employers. The BCIT model: fast, flexible and effective BCIT’s Bachelor of Accounting is offered as: Flexible Learning: The flexible part-time program allows you to maintain your career and study at the same time. You can register course by course, and apply for admission to the program any time. Or Full-Time Day Stream: This program is offered on a full-time basis for those students who want to accelerate their completion of the program. The program starts every September and January. International study BCIT offers a number of international study opportunities that helps students gain a global perspective of the economy, culture, government, and everyday life of the country they study in. You could participate in a summer field school or complete an international degree. Learn more about studying abroad . Next up Entrance Requirements

conditions.description: International applicants This program is available to international applicants. Study permit: A valid BCIT study permit is required prior to starting the program. The optional Workplace Education courses, FMGT 7610 and FMGT 7620, are not available to international students. Post-graduation Work Permit (PGWP) eligibility : This program currently meets the PGWP eligibility requirements based on study program - graduates with a bachelor’s degree and is eligible for students to apply for a PGWP. There are no field of study requirements (CIP) for graduates with a bachelor’s degree. Students are responsible for meeting all Immigration, Refugees, and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) PGWP eligibility requirements . Final PGWP approval is at the discretion of IRCC.

program.program_overview: The Bachelor of Accounting program offers an academic credential leading to a Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation. Choose between part-time Flexible Learning or full-time day stream options. Apply today to develop essential technical, communication, and problem-solving skills for success in the accounting field. Delivery: in person. See details . If you have completed a BCIT Accounting , Finance , or Financial Planning diploma, you can earn your Bachelor of Accounting (BAcc) at BCIT. This degree will provide you with an academic credential leading to a CPA (Chartered Professional Accountant ) designation, a MPAcc (Master of Professional Accounting) , or an MBA program. Students completing this program will acquire the key technical, interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills demanded by employers. The BCIT model: fast, flexible and effective BCIT’s Bachelor of Accounting is offered as: Flexible Learning: The flexible part-time program allows you to maintain your career and study at the same time. You can register course by course, and apply for admission to the program any time. Or Full-Time Day Stream: This program is offered on a full-time basis for those students who want to accelerate their completion of the program. The program starts every September and January. International study BCIT offers a number of international study opportunities that helps students gain a global perspective of the economy, culture, government, and everyday life of the country they study in. You could participate in a summer field school or complete an international degree. Learn more about studying abroad . Next up Entrance Requirements

content.text:
I can verify that the **Bachelor of Accounting** is an active, in-person bachelor’s degree at Burnaby, offered full-time or through part-time Flexible Learning. Its published admission thresholds include a **70% diploma GPA** and **67% in English Studies 12 or equivalent**. The curriculum includes courses such as **FMGT 8911 – Strategic Performance Management**, **LIBS 7001 – Critical Reading and Writing**, and **LIBS 7002 – Applied Ethics**.

Confirm directly with BCIT:

- Whether your diploma is considered equivalent and how your second-year subject averages are assessed
- The signed pre-entry assessment and any required bridging or upgrading
- Your final admission decision

Immigration permissions and final PGWP decisions require confirmation with BCIT and IRCC.

[BCIT Bachelor of Accounting program page](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/accounting-bachelor-of-accounting-full-time-part-time-8630bacc/)
